goal: Check whether any approved change request (CR) covers canary-1 at 2026-07-27T09:44:35Z.
what_to_summarize: Any active CRs covering canary-1 at the alert timestamp
CR id, status, window_start, window_end, hosts list, requester
Whether the CR scope matches the observed activity (curl|bash deployment)
If no CR found, explicitly state that no active changes were returned

goal: Check whether root user is an authorized principal on canary-1 in the identity stub.
what_to_summarize: Whether root is authorized on canary-1 (authorized: true/false)
The via field (role-mapping or override) if authorized
Whether root has sudo on canary-1
Whether root user is enabled in the identity system
Any authorized_hosts listing for root that includes canary-1

goal: Look up canary-1 in CMDB to determine its role, criticality, owner, trust edges, and any per-host user overrides.
what_to_summarize: Host role assignment for canary-1
Criticality level (sandbox/dev/preprod/prod)
Owner of canary-1
Trust edges outbound from canary-1
Any per-host users override block
Whether canary-1 is a known host in inventory or absent

goal: Retrieve all Falco alert events and raw process execution events on canary-1 within ±10 minutes of 2026-07-27T09:44:35Z to reconstruct the full process lineage, command lines, parent processes, fetched URLs, and any base64-decoded payload content.
what_to_summarize: Falco rule names and priorities fired on canary-1 around the alert time
Process names, PIDs, parent PIDs, and command lines from Falco output_fields
The full curl command line including the URL being fetched
The bash command line and any base64-encoded payload
Process ancestry: parent process name (proc.pname) for each event
Any network connection details (destination IP, port, protocol) associated with the curl
User.name and loginuid/tty fields from Falco events
Timeline ordering of events (spawn → pipe → decode → execute)

params.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T09:34:35Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T09:54:35Z"
        AND host.name == "canary-1"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           priority  = falco.priority,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           cmdline   = falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
           user      = falco.output_fields.user.name,
           loginuid  = falco.output_fields.user.loginuid,
           tty       = falco.output_fields.proc.tty
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 100

goal: Capture the current process tree on canary-1 to identify any running curl, bash, or decoded payload processes, and assess the process ancestry for signs of adversary execution.

Any processes with base64, wget, or download-related command lines
The captured_at timestamp for this observation
